clean.tx: umatédo abülfekha khomilobo
clean.tl: They told that a certain man had died.

clean.tx: nu ifekha misafi guptekhé fédop
clean.tl: I want to give there things to you.

clean.tx: mbisifekha nu fédom
clean.tl: Give me a steel axe!

clean.tx: ...ifexa bandoxenè leméné
clean.tl: …you should take this and eat it!

clean.tx: leméndaxu noxu lépteloxaixa...
clean.tl: You must eat it and if we fall ill…

clean.tx: ifexa abülefè xoŋgélxayan wafexa abülefè bexoŋgéteboda
clean.tl: This man is bigger than that man.

clean.tx: Faül dadüaitofexo Faül ülnè bulmexoxafefè Faül banggolol yaüyapé fenè futofexo méan dadüai méan ülnè bul méanmanopyabéntompexo dibéamodaxu ifexo wolaxip wolaxifexa Faül müfe‑xolol di lamé‑abo‑lu
clean.tl: Faül came swimming downstream, after having killed and slaughtered Faül, he put its chest bone part beneath, and its back bone part he placed towards the sky and having killed and butchered a dog that came swimming downstream, he cut out the fat of the dog's chest and greased the back bone part of Faül and he chased it upward in a hurry.

clean.tx: i lal xafén‑telo‑bo i wafil élo‑bo
clean.tl: the wife stayed awake, the husband was asleep.

clean.tx: élobodo ülmexo duolmo
clean.tl: Hei.

clean.tx: ülmexo duolmotofexo gebelipexodaxu melilan felé
clean.tl: Hei started from sleep and fell into the fireplace.

clean.tx: melilan felétofexo i lato yewafil atilo
clean.tl: He fell into the fireplace and the woman held her husband down.

clean.tx: atilodompexo lelip atibatédaxu ülmetédaxu mintafi laifatédaxu bandoailofexo fenè fetédaxu lu xaim melil dimexeté
clean.tl: She held him down, and together they held him down and killed him and carried the wealth items down and put them there and climbed up and set the tree house on fire.

clean.tx: gexené gufe‑tin‑da gexené belén‑è déxa lexé é lenggilé‑tédaxu yaxatimexe‑té
clean.tl: Because he said “you must not demand compensation payments, don't you do that”, they became frightened and revoked

clean.tx: lenggilé‑tédaxu yaxatimexe‑tédo è babofexo ye‑pa fe‑nè fodaxu
clean.tl: They were frightened and renounced and..uh…he stayed until he himself married and…

clean.tx: xomboxai dédo éba éba ébodo nu be‑ba‑lé
clean.tl: She agreed and they slept, they slept and he slept and I sat down.

clean.tx: ébodo ülmexo‑ülmexo‑ma‑té
clean.tl: He slept and they gave him several injections.

clean.tx: wofexa mbolowè gembambampexo ifexa bandoxenè lémé
clean.tl: Oh forefather over there, with your children, you should take this and eat it!

clean.tx: lémdaxu noxup délo füono gol fédomdo lefénè
clean.tl: Eat and give birds and marsupials and pigs for us to eat!

clean.tx: damol fo fenè fu wotofexa mbolofexo gemambümpexo geyanofexo genixülfexo ifexa bandoxenè leméné
clean.tl: And having put down the back part , “hey, you forefather of that certain sacred place, with your children, your people and your wives, you should take this and eat it!”

clean.tx: Bume‑ma‑tédaxu ol di fenè fu‑ma‑tédo ni‑xüto bando‑xe‑nè ao‑ma‑té
clean.tl: They slaughter it and remove the intestines and put it down and the women take and cleanse them.

clean.tx: Aoleful‑mexo xaim gilfo‑ma‑tédo gol‑e‑xal difu‑ma‑té
clean.tl: When they have finished washing, they go away to the treehouse and cut the pig meat out and put it down.

clean.tx: nu naxa nu neyanop nu naxa lexelibandoxaxele delé
clean.tl: he is mine, he belongs to me, let me cut his ties and take him with me, I said

clean.tx: naxa lexelibandoxaxelé delélofexo tidak gu belexelibandoxainda
clean.tl: what is mine I will unbind and take with me, I said but , no, you are not taking him away

clean.tx: ü détofexo a gu ü dunda gupa üaxalé dé
clean.tl: Ow, hei said and hej said, ah you must not say, ow, I will kill you also

clean.tx: déxa lexé lenggilédaxu yaxatimexo
clean.tl: Because hej said that, hei was afraid and renounced

clean.tx: le‑botofexo nggé nabul nu ne‑banun bimo‑m dé
clean.tl: He came and said, Friend, brother-in-law, you must have a look at my back

clean.tx: dédo a ati woxelimexodo ü yi‑pa xayo baosa‑m‑bo mé‑lai
clean.tl: He said, and as they turned him around, Ow, my!, he had come pierced with arrows!

clean.tx: yaxofexalo wofexa amomémo?
clean.tl: Who just did that?

clean.tx: mülalüp nupa amobalé
clean.tl: I myself have done things like that in former times

clean.tx: dédaxufexo n‑atélo wa‑monè umodo dai‑ba‑lé
clean.tl: He told it to my father and likewise he told it and I listened.

clean.tx: le‑méndaxu noxu im
clean.tl: you must eat and keep taking care of us

clean.tx: wa‑mol‑mo mamaf bau
clean.tl: They usually do like that and then after a little while…

clean.tx: gexenép anè xa‑méné dédo él de‑nè xenè lapanggafexo xai‑ba‑lèdo pesau maunan pesahu lai
clean.tl: She told us to go and we agreed and we waited at the airstrip until the plane landed on the river.

clean.tx: amotofexo noxupeninggi bandoai fe‑nè futofexo
clean.tl: It did so and he brought our evangelist and…

clean.tx: a noxup xeyop é‑fu‑ba‑lèlofexo sü‑lexé ne bu‑lelo‑ba‑lé
clean.tl: In the house we slept and I was teasing for tobacco.

clean.tx: amo‑xa‑télexa minya alipta alü‑xa‑léf de‑ba‑lé
clean.tl: If you do so, I will raise a fire here by means of petro­leum, I said

clean.tx: Ye loxtédo walüpta walüpta maxaya au‑pexodo wafexo ye xülo ye xe‑bofexo gupto anè da‑mo‑mé dé
clean.tl: He went away and halfway a maxaya‑bat squeaked and there he went upstream and he commanded , let me know.

clean.tx: xe‑nè da‑mo‑mé dédo ye loxté
clean.tl: And after he commanded, `you should let me know, he went away.

clean.tx: le‑méndaxu mano‑pa‑mon
clean.tl: You should eat it and help !

clean.tx: mesé xobülfexo wotofexa fo fe‑nè fu‑ma‑té
clean.tl: And then they usually take another leg and put it down on another sacred place, and..

clean.tx: noxup N. atilamelèdaxu gup falaxololo? xenè yanop mébol lélémbatèlexolo? delè
clean.tl: We had caught and bound N.

clean.tx: delèlofexo él yup mündiyoptanux yemayoxfexo yanop mébol xebatè dé
clean.tl: We said and, yes he had gone only once with his mates to a grave, he said.

clean.tx: yo anè umom delèlofexo a gülé alümexon alümexonta yemayoxfexo yanop mébol xatè dé
clean.tl: Come on tell us, we said and, uh, on a clear moonlit night with full moon he and his companions had gone to a burial site, he said.

clean.tx: xatètofexo yanop laxül yelidoptanux faxtenè lufalébo dé
clean.tl: They had gone and one corpse had floated up and had made an appearance, he said.

clean.tx: Alobodompexo maun nenilfobodompexo sendoktompexo alimimématèfexo yu alifédatétofexo gololo.
clean.tl: It stood up and there was much fluid and they had just begun to scoop it up with a spoon and drink it and then they scooped it up for him to drink but he was afraid.

clean.tx: gololotofexo atibatédaxu yaxaxolofan alimexetédo medompexo wasü sendoktofexo yanop nénax alimixamibaxatifexo külmexetédaxufexo yexenép xaunngga lexemematétofexo yanop loxül xaumeléaido yexenép gilfaté dé
clean.tl: He was afraid and then they held him and scooped the corpse fluid into his mouth and he drank it and they were scooping and drinking corpse fluid there until they were done and then they wanted to go away and when the corpse had sunk, they left, he said.

flagged.tl: You must eat it and if we fall ill, cure us and let us be healthy.

orig.tl: You must eat it and if we fall ill, cure us and let us be healthy.
